blocks.text: Managing Slack notifications for QA focus

As a QA tester, you need quiet time to run test suites or write automation scripts. Slack notifications often break your concentration. To fix this, use the Do Not Disturb feature. Click your profile picture in the bottom left corner. Select Pause notifications. Choose a time frame that matches your current testing task.
You can also use the /dnd slash command followed by a time. For example, type /dnd 30 minutes to pause alerts for half an hour.
blocks.title: Quick DND command

blocks.text: Speed is vital when you are juggling multiple bug reports. Learn these shortcuts to navigate the Slack app on your Mac. Press Command + K to open the Quick Switcher. This lets you jump to any conversation by typing its name. Use Command + / to see the full list of shortcuts inside Slack.

items: Command + Shift + A: Open the All Unreads view.
Command + Shift + T: Open the Threads view.
Command + F: Search in the current channel.
Shift + Enter: Create a new line in your message without sending it.
Command + B: Bold text for emphasis in bug reports.

blocks.text: How Lazur helps you in Slack

Lazur is a voice assistant that lives in your Mac notch. It helps you manage your Slack workspace without needing to click through menus. Hold the Option + Command keys to ask Lazur about anything on your screen. If you are stuck in a complex Slack thread, ask Lazur to explain the context or point at a specific button you need.

If Slack feels slow, your cache might be full. Go to the Help menu in the top bar. Select Troubleshooting. Choose Clear Cache and Restart. This often resolves performance issues that happen after long sessions of testing and file sharing.
Structuring your bug reports in Slack

When you report a bug in Slack, clarity matters. Always include the app version, steps to reproduce, and the expected result. Use the Shift + Enter shortcut to keep your report clean. If you need to draft a long report, dictate your thoughts using the fn key.

QA testers often monitor workspaces for different clients or projects. Use the sidebar to switch between workspaces. You can also use Command + ` to cycle through your open Slack windows. This keeps your communication organized and prevents you from posting a bug report in the wrong channel.

Many testers use Slack integrations to track Jira or Linear tickets. Check your workspace settings to see which apps are active. Use the search bar to find specific tickets by ID. This prevents you from switching back and forth between your browser and Slack constantly.

faq.question: How do I jump to a specific conversation in Slack?
faq.answer: Press Command + K on your Mac to open the Quick Switcher and type the name of the channel or person.

faq.question: Can I use voice to dictate bug reports in Slack?
faq.answer: Yes, hold the fn key on your Mac to dictate text directly into the Slack message field.

faq.question: What should I do if Slack is crashing on my Mac?
faq.answer: Go to Help > Troubleshooting > Clear Cache and Restart to reset the app state.

faq.question: Does Lazur work inside the Slack app?
faq.answer: Yes, Lazur works in any app on your Mac. You can ask it to explain UI elements or help you draft messages while Slack is open.
